_note: INVENTED EXAMPLE. Sam is a made-up bookkeeper and the shop is made up. Every number is invented to show the format. This deck ends on a diagram, so it has no call-to-action slide (a diagram must be the last slide).

slides.title: Three habits that changed one small shop
Photograph receipts at the till
slides.does: The phone photo goes straight into one shared folder, before the paper has a chance to go missing.
slides.got: No more lost receipts at the end of the quarter.

slides.title: Twelve fixed categories
slides.does: Every cost goes into one of twelve categories chosen once, so nothing needs deciding at month end.
slides.got: Month-end sorting went from a whole weekend to forty minutes.

slides.title: Reconcile on Fridays
slides.does: Match the bank feed against the receipts folder for fifteen minutes every Friday afternoon.
slides.got: The year-end pack reached the accountant three weeks early.

caption: INVENTED EXAMPLE CAPTION. Same shop, same owner, three habits.
